mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PASSWORD_RESET (RESET_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, TOKEN_HASH, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_PASSWORD_RESET.NEXTVAL, #{accountId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PASSWORD_RESET WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND CREATED_AT > #{since}
mapper.update: UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET SET USED_AT = #{now} WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND USED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET SET USED_AT = #{now} WHERE RESET_ID = #{resetId} AND USED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRES_AT > #{now}
